mapper.select: select * from chat_room as c_room join chat_member as c_member on c_room.room_id = c_member.room_id where c_member.sabun = #{sabun}
mapper.insert: insert into chat_message(room_id, sender_sabun, saname, content, sent_at) values(#{room_id}, #{sender_sabun}, #{saname}, #{content}, now());
